## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block to DONGGUAN SOLUM ELECTRONICS CO.,LTD, oddly at an address in the Tianjin free trade zone rather than in Dongguan [1]. Import records on Panjiva place the company in the Nan Fang industrial area of Humen, Dongguan, name television and conveyor as its top products, and list Samsung SDS America, Super Micro Computer and Solum America among its US consignees, with Solum Electronics Mexicana in Tijuana as a notify party [2].

The shared name and those trading partners suggest a factory of the Korean SOLUM group, which was spun off from Samsung Electro-Mechanics in 2015 and whose business units are ESL and IoT, display, automotive and power, sensor and lifestyle [3]. No source in hand states that ownership, so parent is unknown, and the registry's separate solum block in Yongin, Korea, is a different registry name and not an alias [1].

What a MAC in this block is cannot be stated from the sources reached: the Panjiva commodity text is redacted, SOLUM's own pages do not name its sites, and the FCC ID databases refused automated access, so radios, silicon, FCC grantee codes and randomization are unknown.
